name: Spanish Common Words Set 7
description: This is part of a larger set of common Spanish words.

cards.irregularForms: gozo, gozas, goza, gozamos, gozáis, gozan (presente); gozado (participio); gozando (gerundio)
cards.sentence: Me gusta gozar de la vida cada día.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to enjoy life every day.

cards.sentence: La oficina está cerrada por vacaciones.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The office is closed for holidays.

cards.sentence: Mi pueblo es pequeño y tranquilo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My town is small and quiet.

cards.sentence: Condujimos por una carretera larga y recta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We drove down a long, straight road.

cards.sentence: La lluvia no nos detuvo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The rain didn't stop us.

cards.sentence: Una nube gris cubrió el sol.
cards.sentenceTranslation: A gray cloud covered the sun.

cards.sentence: En invierno, aquí cae mucha nieve.
cards.sentenceTranslation: In winter, a lot of snow falls here.

cards.sentence: Fuimos a la playa para nadar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We went to the beach to swim.

cards.sentence: Exploramos el bosque durante horas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We explored the forest for hours.

cards.sentence: El lago es perfecto para la pesca.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The lake is perfect for fishing.

cards.sentence: El vasto océano se extendía ante nosotros.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The vast ocean stretched before us.

cards.sentence: Soñamos con visitar una isla tropical.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We dream of visiting a tropical island.

cards.sentence: Atravesaron el desierto bajo el sol ardiente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: They crossed the desert under the burning sun.

cards.sentence: Encontró una piedra brillante en el camino.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He found a shiny stone on the path.

cards.sentence: La estatua está hecha de metal antiguo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The statue is made of old metal.

cards.sentence: La mesa es de madera maciza.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The table is made of solid wood.

cards.sentence: Cuidado, el vaso es de cristal fino.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Be careful, the glass is fine crystal.

cards.sentence: Evitemos usar tanto plástico.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Let's avoid using so much plastic.

cards.sentence: Se me acabó la tinta de la impresora.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I ran out of ink in the printer.

cards.sentence: Necesito un lápiz para escribir.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need a pencil to write.

cards.sentence: Prefiero usar un bolígrafo azul.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I prefer to use a blue pen.

cards.sentence: Anoto mis ideas en un cuaderno.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I write down my ideas in a notebook.

cards.sentence: El profesor escribió en la pizarra.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The teacher wrote on the board.

cards.sentence: Llevaba todos sus libros en la mochila.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He carried all his books in his backpack.

cards.sentence: Mira la hora en mi reloj.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Look at the time on my watch.

cards.sentence: Se miró en el espejo antes de salir.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She looked at herself in the mirror before leaving.

cards.sentence: Pintamos la pared de color blanco.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We painted the wall white.

cards.sentence: El techo de la casa es muy alto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The house's ceiling is very high.

cards.sentence: El suelo estaba mojado por la lluvia.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The floor was wet from the rain.

cards.sentence: Pasamos la tarde en el jardín.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We spent the afternoon in the garden.

cards.sentence: Mi dormitorio tiene una cama grande.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My bedroom has a big bed.

cards.sentence: Nos reunimos en la sala de estar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We met in the living room.

cards.sentence: Compramos un mueble nuevo para el salón.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We bought a new piece of furniture for the living room.

cards.sentence: Por favor, dame un vaso de agua.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Please, give me a glass of water.

cards.sentence: Sirvió la comida en un plato hondo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He served the food on a deep plate.

cards.sentence: Cortó el pan con un cuchillo afilado.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He cut the bread with a sharp knife.

cards.sentence: Comió la ensalada con un tenedor.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She ate the salad with a fork.

cards.sentence: Necesito una cuchara para la sopa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need a spoon for the soup.

cards.sentence: Prepararé la cena para las ocho.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I will prepare dinner for eight o'clock.

cards.sentence: El desayuno es la comida más importante.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Breakfast is the most important meal.

cards.sentence: Nos vemos para el almuerzo al mediodía.
cards.sentenceTranslation: See you for lunch at noon.

cards.sentence: Tengo mucha hambre, ¿qué hay para comer?
cards.sentenceTranslation: I'm very hungry, what's there to eat?

cards.sentence: Después de correr, tenía mucha sed.
cards.sentenceTranslation: After running, I was very thirsty.

cards.sentence: Estoy cansado después de un largo día.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I am tired after a long day.

cards.sentence: Hace mucho calor en verano.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It's very hot in summer.

cards.sentence: Necesito comprar ropa nueva.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need to buy new clothes.

cards.sentence: Este zapato me aprieta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This shoe is tight on me.

cards.sentence: Llevaba un sombrero de paja.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He was wearing a straw hat.

cards.sentence: Busqué las llaves en mi bolsillo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I looked for the keys in my pocket.

cards.sentence: Mi gato es mi mascota favorita.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My cat is my favorite pet.

cards.sentence: Montó el caballo por la pradera.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He rode the horse through the meadow.

cards.sentence: La vaca da leche fresca.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The cow gives fresh milk.

cards.sentence: El cerdo es un animal de granja.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The pig is a farm animal.

cards.sentence: Pescó un gran pez en el río.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He caught a big fish in the river.

cards.sentence: Había un insecto raro en la ventana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: There was a strange insect on the window.

cards.sentence: Regué la planta todas las mañanas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I watered the plant every morning.

cards.sentence: Cada semilla puede convertirse en un árbol.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Every seed can become a tree.

cards.sentence: La velocidad del coche era impresionante.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The car's speed was impressive.

cards.sentence: Están en peligro si no actúan rápido.
cards.sentenceTranslation: They are in danger if they don't act fast.

cards.sentence: Todos buscan la justicia.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Everyone seeks justice.

cards.sentence: La nueva ley entrará en vigor pronto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The new law will come into effect soon.

cards.sentence: La policía investiga el crimen.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The police are investigating the crime.

cards.sentence: El castigo fue muy severo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The punishment was very severe.

cards.sentence: Valoran la libertad por encima de todo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: They value freedom above all else.

cards.sentence: En la historia, muchas personas fueron esclavas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: In history, many people were slaves.

cards.sentence: El rey gobernó con sabiduría.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The king ruled wisely.

cards.sentence: La reina asistirá al evento.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The queen will attend the event.

cards.sentence: El príncipe visitó el pueblo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The prince visited the town.

cards.sentence: La princesa era conocida por su bondad.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The princess was known for her kindness.

cards.sentence: El guerrero luchó valientemente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The warrior fought bravely.

cards.sentence: El soldado defendió su patria.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The soldier defended his homeland.

cards.sentence: No le gustaba usar ningún tipo de arma.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He didn't like to use any kind of weapon.

cards.sentence: Ganaron la batalla decisiva.
cards.sentenceTranslation: They won the decisive battle.

cards.sentence: Nuestra amistad es muy importante para mí.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Our friendship is very important to me.

cards.sentence: Busca la felicidad en las pequeñas cosas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She seeks happiness in the small things.

cards.sentence: Su enojo era evidente en su rostro.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His anger was evident on his face.

cards.sentence: Me llevé una gran sorpresa al verlo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I got a big surprise when I saw him.

cards.sentence: Sentí vergüenza por mi error.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I felt shame for my mistake.

cards.sentence: Tuvo un fuerte dolor de cabeza.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He had a severe headache.

cards.sentence: Se recuperó de una enfermedad grave.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She recovered from a serious illness.

cards.sentence: El doctor le recetó un medicamento.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The doctor prescribed him a medication.

cards.sentence: Lo llevaron al hospital de urgencia.
cards.sentenceTranslation: They took him to the emergency hospital.

cards.sentence: Estudia medicina en la universidad.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She studies medicine at the university.

cards.sentence: Necesitaba una cirugía en la rodilla.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He needed knee surgery.

cards.sentence: Me duele el pie derecho.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My right foot hurts.

cards.sentence: Levantó el brazo para saludar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He raised his arm to wave.

cards.sentence: Se rompió la pierna jugando al fútbol.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He broke his leg playing soccer.

cards.sentence: Su nariz estaba roja por el frío.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His nose was red from the cold.

cards.sentence: Escuchó un ruido extraño en su oído.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He heard a strange noise in his ear.

cards.sentence: Le dolía un diente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He had a toothache.

cards.sentence: Tenía el cabello largo y rubio.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She had long, blond hair.

cards.sentence: El cerebro controla todas las funciones del cuerpo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The brain controls all body functions.

cards.sentence: Tenía el estómago vacío.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His stomach was empty.

cards.sentence: Donar sangre puede salvar vidas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Donating blood can save lives.

cards.sentence: El perro estaba mordiendo un hueso.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The dog was chewing on a bone.

cards.sentence: El tamaño de la caja es perfecto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The size of the box is perfect.

cards.sentence: El levantador de pesas levantó un gran peso.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The weightlifter lifted a great weight.

cards.sentence: La altura de la montaña era impresionante.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The mountain's height was impressive.

cards.sentence: El pastel tenía un sabor delicioso.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The cake had a delicious taste.

cards.sentence: El olor a pan recién horneado era maravilloso.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The smell of freshly baked bread was wonderful.
